title: A forecast of self-control
hook: Two stated cases: explore how much contrary evidence changes a belief.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How how much contrary evidence changes a belief affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare how much contrary evidence changes a belief in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
